body:
## Result

The in-game statistics panel and post-match graphs now show per-team blocked units/buildings, current versus structural blockage, 25/50/75% health and food bands, and actual natural resource growth at global and 8/16/32-tile distances. Existing death causes are exposed as separate graph metrics. New snapshots are sampled at the existing 512-tick boundary; growth events read one packed tile mask, and changed building footprints update contiguous overlap counts only at sampling boundaries. Save format 108 preserves the active growth-coverage anchors while keeping the version-58 save loading floor.

## Validation

- Complete per-tick sidecars match the parent build byte for byte: 1,024 ticks on the four-AI save and 2,048 ticks on the 12-team save. A format-108 checkpoint reload also matches all 256 parent team/entity checksum records.
- Save/statistics harness, old version-84/88 save fixtures, save-safety, distributed-telemetry, translation audit and font-coverage tests pass. Six graph pages and both live-panel measurement pages render at 640×480 and 1024×768. Non-English diagnostic labels combine each catalog’s existing translated base terms with compact cutoff notation.
- Median process user CPU in six mirrored ABBA/BAAB blocks: four AI, 2.963s → 2.948s (−0.48%) over 8,192 ticks; 12 teams, 4.902s → 4.891s (−0.24%) over 2,048 ticks. Peak resident memory on the 12-team run rose 7.80 MiB for coverage overlap counts and expanded history.
- Raw commands, binary/save hashes, CPU JSON, checksum fixtures, version-108 checkpoint, logs and screenshots: [validation evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/feat/gameplay-telemetry-expansion/test/fixtures/team-stats/telemetry-expansion-validation/README.md).

A save/load divergence on the four-AI fixture already exists in the parent build; both versions first diverge from their uninterrupted run at the same tick after checkpoint reload. Their reloaded team/entity traces match each other. Aggregate checksums include the saved map-header minor version, so a 107/108 save comparison needs the detailed records. This PR changes no orders, RNG, AI decisions, replay acceptance floor (99), or YOG protocol gate (33). Core gameplay and feel are expected to remain the same. Manual play and platform CPU profiling were not part of local validation; Linux and Windows CI checksum/save checks must pass before merge.
title: Add sampled team blockage, growth, and threshold telemetry
